goal: Build a password-protected admin dashboard for managing content and bookings.
summary: Phase 3 completed. Built a password-protected admin CMS dashboard with: admin layout and auth guard; courses CRUD; blog posts CRUD (with added excerpt fields); site content sections CRUD; and bookings management with status updates. All admin routes are protected by the (admin) layout, and build/lint pass.
stepSummaries:
1. Create admin layout with auth guard redirecting non-admin users. Creates app/(admin)/layout.tsx and app/(admin)/page.tsx. [verified]
  2. Implement courses CRUD (list, create, edit, delete) using server actions and forms. Creates app/(admin)/courses/ and lib/actions/courses.ts. [verified]
  3. Implement blog posts CRUD. Creates app/(admin)/blog/ and lib/actions/blog.ts. [verified]
  4. Implement site content sections CRUD (hero, about, contact info). Creates app/(admin)/content/ and lib/actions/content.ts. [verified]
  5. Implement bookings management view (list, status update). Creates app/(admin)/bookings/ and lib/actions/bookings.ts. [verified]
evidence: Created app/(admin)/layout.tsx with getServerSession auth guard; app/(admin)/page.tsx dashboard; lib/actions/courses.ts + app/(admin)/courses/*; lib/actions/blog.ts + app/(admin)/blog/* + BlogPost excerpt migration; lib/actions/content.ts + app/(admin)/content/* + ContentSection model/migration; lib/actions/bookings.ts + app/(admin)/bookings/* + Booking model/enums update migration. Verified npm run lint and npm run build exit 0 for every step; build output shows all admin routes.
reviewerRationale: All gates pass; project checks validate.

gateVerdicts.rationale: Every step used real behavioral verification via lint and build; no proxy-only steps.
gateVerdicts.evidence: All five steps verified with npm run lint and npm run build exiting 0; route tables confirmed admin routes exist.

gateVerdicts.rationale: Combined output delivers the phase goal: a password-protected admin dashboard with CRUD for courses, blog posts, content sections, and booking management.
gateVerdicts.evidence: app/(admin)/layout.tsx enforces ADMIN role and redirects unauthorized users; CRUD pages and server actions exist for all four management areas.

gateVerdicts.rationale: No remaining deferred work in this phase.
